title: Land Title Deed / Registered Lease Verification
description: Institute must hold clear title or minimum 30-year registered lease deed from competent state revenue authority.

title: University Affiliation Letter Authenticity
description: Valid annual or permanent affiliation letter issued by affiliating State/Central University for current academic year.

title: NBA/NAAC Accreditation Validity
description: Accreditation must be valid for applications proposing increase in intake or launching new courses.

title: State Fire Safety Certificate Compliance
description: Building fire safety certificate issued by State Fire Service, valid for the entire academic cycle.

title: Minimum Instructional Carpet Area per Student
description: Minimum instructional carpet area of 4.5 sq.m per enrolled student across classrooms and tutorial blocks.

title: Laboratories to Course Ratio
description: At least 6 dedicated, fully equipped laboratories per undergraduate engineering/technology specialization.

title: Cross-Institute Duplicate Document Detection
description: Cryptographic file hash (SHA256) and text perceptual fingerprint must be unique across all AICTE institute filings.

title: Digital Document Metadata and ELA Verification
description: Scanned letters and PDFs must show consistent creation timestamps and pass visual error-level tampering analysis.
